## Corriger données d'identité

```{r}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M2_A1 <- M2_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db, -id_date_creation, -(id_centre1:id_centre3), -(id_dep_nais:id_age), 
  -(sc_type:id_age_cat_3)) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  ))

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M2_A2 <- M2_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M2_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  )

rm(list = c("M2_A0", "M2_A1"))
```

```{r}

rm_ps <- M2_A2 %>%

rm_fa_plan <- M2_A2 %>%

    colnames()

M2_B0 <- M2_A2 %>% 
        rename_with(~ gsub("^ps", "sc", .x), all_of(rm_ps)) %>%
        rename_with(~ gsub("^fa", "sc", .x), all_of(rm_fa_plan)) %>%
        rename(
        "sc_commentaires" = "commentaires_scol",
        "sc_debut_an" = "sc_an_debut",
        "sc_fin_etudes" = "fa_fin_etudes",
        "sc_formation" = "fa_formation",
        "sc_formation_autre" = "fa_formation_autre",
        "sc_diplome" = "fa_diplome",
        "sc_diplome_autre" = "fa_diplome_autre",
        "sc_diplome_an" = "fa_an_diplome"
    ) %>%  
        relocate(c("sc_debut", "sc_debut_autre", "sc_debut_an", "sc_redoubl",
        "sc_interromp", "sc_plan", "sc_plan_an"), .after = sc_date_creation) %>% 
            relocate(c(sc_plan_ets1_1:sc_plan_notification_autre), .after = sc_plan_an) %>%

            relocate(sc_commentaires, .after = sc_diplome_an) %>% 
            relocate(sc_debut_corr, .after = sc_debut_autre) %>% 
            relocate(c(sc_date_debut:sc_age_debut), .after = sc_debut_an) %>% 
            relocate(etspps, .after = sc_plan_an) %>%

    ) 

rm(list = c("rm_fa_plan", "rm_ps"))

```

## Identifier les absents

Ici, on va exclure les variables des questions S1 et S2 parce que tout le monde y a répondu, mais 53 personnes ont arrêté de participer au questionnaire à partir de ce point. Donc ces personnes seront comptées comme n'ayant pas participé au module, même si elles ont répondu à deux questions.
```{r}

vars_check <- M2_B1 %>%
  select(starts_with("sc_"), -sc_date_creation, -starts_with("sc_debut")) %>%
  colnames()

M2_B2 <- M2_B1 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    sc_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

## Retirer les doublons
 
```{r}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M2_B2 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>%
  fill(c("add_sc_debut_corr", "add_sc_debut_age"), .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(sc_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M2_C0 <- M2_B2 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat) %>% 
  rename(
    "sc_rd_redoubl" = "sc_redoubl",
    "sc_in_interromp" = "sc_interromp"
  )

rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr"))
rm(list = c("M2_A2", "M2_B0", "M2_B1", "M2_B2"))

```

## Corriger variables générées

## Recoder NAs

```{r}

rcd_na_1rep_simple <- function(df, complet, vars_1rep_simple){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars_1rep_simple}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_na_1rep_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, concerned, vars_1rep_borne){

  if ({{concerned}} == 1){
    skip  <-  0
  } else if ({{concerned}} == 0){
    skip  <-  1
  }

  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of({{vars_1rep_borne}}), ~ replace_when(
          .x,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == {{concerned}} ~ -9,
          is.na(.x) & {{borne}} == skip ~ -1
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_na_QCM_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, concerned, vars_QCM_borne){

  if ({{concerned}} == 1){
    skip  <-  0
  } else if ({{concerned}} == 0){
    skip  <-  1
  }

  df %>% 
    mutate(
      none_selected = if_all({{vars_QCM_borne}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
      mutate(
        across(
          all_of({{vars_QCM_borne}}), ~ replace_when(
            .x,
            is.na(.x) & !none_selected ~ 0,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == {{concerned}} ~ -9,
            none_selected & {{borne}} == skip ~ -1
          )
        )
      ) %>% 
        select(-none_selected)
}


```


```{r}

vars_1rep_simple <- M2_D2 %>% 
  select(sc_plan, sc_plan_demande, sc_fin_etudes, sc_diplome, sc_diplome_an,
```

```{r}

elementaire <- M2_E0 %>%

college <- M2_E0 %>%

sc_plan_niveau <- function(df, var_niv, vars_QCM_niv){

  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{var_niv}} := case_when(
        sc_plan == -2 ~ -2,
      sc_plan == 0 ~ -1,
      sc_plan == -9 | if_all(starts_with("sc_plan_ets"), ~ .x == -9) ~ -9,
      sc_plan == 1 & if_any({{vars_QCM_niv}}, ~ .x == 1) ~ 1,
      sc_plan == 1 & if_all({{vars_QCM_niv}}, ~ .x == 0) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ -3456436
      ),
      .before = sc_etspps
    )
  
}

M2_E1 <- M2_E0 %>% 
  sc_plan_niveau("sc_plan_elementaire", all_of(elementaire)) %>% 
  sc_plan_niveau("sc_plan_college", all_of(college)) %>% 
  sc_plan_niveau("sc_plan_lycee", all_of(lycee))

etspps_long <- M2_E1 %>% 
  select(id_keep, sc_plan:sc_plan_ets5_14) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("sc_plan_ets"),
    names_to = c("ets", "niveau"),
    names_pattern = "sc_plan_ets(.)_(.*)"
  ) %>% 
    mutate(across(ets:niveau, as.integer))

etspps_long2 <- etspps_long %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  mutate(
    sc_plan_ets_debut = case_when(
      value == 1 & niveau == min(niveau[value == 1], na.rm = TRUE) ~ ets,
      value == -9 ~ -9,
      value == -2 ~ -2,
      value == -1 ~ -1,
      value == 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      value == 1 & niveau != min(niveau[value == 1], na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ -93486793
    ),
    sc_plan_ets_fin = case_when(
      value == 1 & niveau == max(niveau[value == 1], na.rm = TRUE) ~ ets,
      value == -9 ~ -9,
      value == -2 ~ -2,
      value == -1 ~ -1,
      value == 0 ~ NA_integer_,
      value == 1 & niveau != max(niveau[value == 1], na.rm = TRUE) ~ NA_integer_,
      TRUE ~ -93486793
    )
  )

clean <- etspps_long2 %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id_keep, sc_plan, sc_plan_ets_debut, sc_plan_ets_fin) %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  fill(sc_plan_ets_debut, .direction = "downup") %>% 
  fill(sc_plan_ets_fin, .direction = "downup") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(id_keep, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(-sc_plan)


M2_E2 <- M2_E1 %>% 
  left_join(
    clean,
    by = "id_keep"
  ) %>% 
    relocate(c("sc_plan_ets_debut", "sc_plan_ets_fin"), .after = sc_plan_lycee) %>% 
    select(-sc_etspps)
```

## Traduire réponses libres

```{r}

vars_libres <- M2_E3 %>% 
  select(where(is.character)) %>% 
  select(-id_anonymat) %>% 
  colnames()

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(polyglotr)


# 2. Valeurs uniques, non vides, sur les 6 variables à la fois
textes_uniques <- M2_E3 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_libres)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  discard(~ is.na(.x) || trimws(.x) == "")

fichier_dico <- "dico_sco_traduction.rds"

# Reprend là où on s'était arrêté, si une sauvegarde existe
dico <- if (file.exists(fichier_dico)) readRDS(fichier_dico) else character(0)

traduire <- function(x, essais = 5) {
  for (i in seq_len(essais)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      google_translate(x, target_language = "en",
                                 source_language = "fr"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (length(res) == 1 && !is.na(res)) return(res)
    attente <- 10 * 2^(i - 1)  # 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s, 160 s
    message("Échec, nouvel essai dans ", attente, " s...")
    Sys.sleep(attente)
  }
  NA_character_
}

a_traduire <- setdiff(textes_uniques, names(dico))

for (i in seq_along(a_traduire)) {
  txt <- a_traduire[i]
  dico[txt] <- traduire(txt)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # pause entre chaque requête
  if (i %% 20 == 0) {
    saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)
    message(i, " / ", length(a_traduire), " traduits")
  }
}
saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)

# 4. Application aux 6 colonnes


M2_F0 <- M2_E3 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_libres),
                ~ unname(dico[.x]),
                .names = "{.col}_en"))

for (v in vars_libres) {
  M2_F0 <- relocate(M2_F0, all_of(paste0(v, "_en")), .after = all_of(v))
}



M2_F1 <- M2_F0 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(where(~ is.character(.x) && any(str_detect(.x, "1/3 time|third time|third-time"), na.rm = TRUE)), 
    ~ str_replace_all(
      .x, "1/3 time exams|1/3 time|a third time|additional third time|third time|third-time work|third-time", "additional time"
    ))
  )

readr::write_csv(M2_F1, "data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M2_F1.csv")
```
